limitations: Presentation prototype; production transfer requires a separate user request.
Synthetic profile input formats are intentionally unambiguous and schema-valid, rather than copies of the full published catalog.
Current UI references are inert captures of the real React route; local candidate controls simulate selection, never actual launch/upload.
Only the existing source-review/operation-trace/ASVS/checklist examples are demonstrated; live web scan configuration stays outside this design trial.
